scribe.transcript: Pluto's heart doesn't have a single crater. Stay, and I'll show you why that's strange. In 2015, New Horizons flew past and photographed it. Its great plain is frozen nitrogen gas, no craters anywhere on it, and somehow Pluto's heart stays perfectly smooth

text: Pluto's heart doesn't have a single crater. Stay, and I'll show you why that's strange. In 2015, New Horizons flew past and photographed it. Its great plain is frozen nitrogen gas. No craters anywhere on it. And somehow, Pluto's heart stays perfectly smooth.
